Name: Claude Deck
Author: Bri Alvarez
Description: Monitor Claude Code sessions, token usage, and estimated cost right on your Stream Deck.

Actions.Name: Session
Actions.Tooltip: One Claude Code session per key: shows project, state, and activity. Press to jump to its terminal (or resume it in a new one). Place multiple keys for multiple sessions.

Actions.Name: Approve
Actions.Tooltip: Approve the pending permission request (focuses the session's terminal and presses Return).

Actions.Name: Deny
Actions.Tooltip: Deny the pending permission request (focuses the session's terminal and presses Escape).

Actions.Name: Limits
Actions.Tooltip: Your real Claude plan limits: current 5-hour session %, weekly %, and per-model weekly % — same numbers as /usage. Press to refresh.

Actions.Name: Active Sessions
Actions.Tooltip: Shows how many Claude Code sessions are active right now, and how many were used today.

Actions.Name: Usage
Actions.Tooltip: Claude Code token usage and estimated cost. Press to cycle: Today / Last 5h / Last 7 days.
